notes.title: She's Off.
notes.body: Molly left for Kona yesterday and arrived safely.  She arrived safely, was settling in, and headed to worship when Karen spoke to her last night.  Hawaii is six hours behind.  A hurricane is headed toward Hawaii, so the next couple of days should be interesting.  More to come....Molly's Dad.

notes.title: Lasts
notes.body:
As I get ready to depart, I find myself experiencing a multitude of lasts. For example, my mom and I went to our special park for lunch one last time, and I almost puked from swinging in the oppressing heat for so long. 

We also went to the waterpark that we went to every summer when I was little, and God was smiling down on us because, for the only time ever, the weather was perfect and there were zero lines! Plus, I was so brave; I did the two rides I chickened out of last time. Water went up every orifice, but I did it!

Finally, my dad and I went to Busch Gardens together for the last time. We stopped at the Candy Shoppe so I could get a big bag of sugar, just like my first trip to Busch Gardens, when I had scarlet fever, and my dad was sure a whole bunch of candy would set me straight.

I’ve still got a few more lasts before I leave to experience a whole bunch of firsts, and I’m trying to cherish every one of them. I’m going to miss this chapter of my life, but I know God has great big plans for me. Thanks for reading!

Love, Molly🌳

notes.title: Big News!
notes.body:
Hi, everybody! I know I said I’d update every Saturday, and I’m so sorry I haven’t done that! I’ve been very busy… and I’m a huge procrastinator, but I’m working on it. I just wanted to go ahead and come on here and tell y’all something important. Today, we found out the options for our outreach locations! As soon as I heard them, one place was immediately on my heart. I heard God telling me over and over again, “Colombia, Colombia, Colombia, Colombia.” And I can’t see myself anywhere else for outreach. Of course, I prayed on it, but God only told me what I already knew. I did put the Philippines down as my second choice, but I’m trusting that the staff is praying and that God will tell them where I’m supposed to be. Anyways, I’ll work on updating more. But until then, send your spare change my way (if God leads you to), and pray for Colombia!

Love, Molly 🇨🇴
